scope: Interpretation and next-step recommendation only; no candidate route accepted and no physics/config changed.
verified_stop: Fresh actual 40.735 s, before insert/release; unique recorded rejection is union perimeter, not a native collision or force/stretch/J stop.
key_findings_cn: 原口缘和原预测熊截面需求913.669毫米，距915.233毫米上限仅1.564毫米。换成实际运输后熊而袋不变，需求增15.435毫米；只换实际袋而熊不变，增3.296毫米。新袋新熊合计932.988毫米，超17.756毫米。此分解为几何对照，不是力因果分离。
实际袋口自身XY凸包周长从860.770降至858.208毫米；熊自身含2毫米buffer的最大截面周长598.871毫米。两者各自的尺度未单独耗尽915.233毫米，因此目前拒绝的是它们当前相对布局的联合包络。
去除buffer仍超12.674毫米，不能把2毫米安全余量删除当作修复。腕目标误差仅约0.132毫米，姿态误差0.000303弧度；熊相对TCP的24.142毫米局部形变明显大于腕追踪误差。

toy_counterexample_not_native_or_bag_fea.meaning: An inextensible freely reshaping planar loop of the original length can surround the smaller-perimeter rectangle, but cannot simultaneously enclose every old mouth location and the rectangle. Thus union-perimeter failure is not a general physical impossibility theorem. This ignores held attachments/3D panels and is not evidence that full22 can insert.

bounded_direction_evidence.warning: Not an evaluated candidate. Perimeter is convex in translation; a local linear decrease can be optimistic, so this distance does not certify feasible alignment. The previous negative-Y rigid-clearance problem also remains relevant.

recommended_next_step_cn: 优先复用现有实际状态复观测和有预算的recenter机制，让所有原section/8mm刚体/5mm熊扫掠/速率/两提带条件先检查同一完整修正及下降路径。只有一条实际状态路线完整通过后，下一配置才可显式开启recenter并列出该有证据偏移；不沿用yaw时仅1.6毫米余量的冻结对齐，也不删除周长门。
if_no_current_recenter_passes_cn: 停在该失败结论；当前没有已验证的小偏移可直接启动。若改变持袋姿态或抓持点，必须先真实生成并保存新的稳定袋形，再重新检查完整路线，不能虚拟移动袋口后称可行。
review_boundary: No claim of whole-body containment, strain feasibility, original nonconvex collision safety, or successful insertion. Unheld rear-strap contact remains a separate declared physical-trial risk.
